title: FY 2024-25 has an unknown-cost sale and a known LTCL of Rs 40,000: loss amount unknown, not set off against FY 2025-26 LTCG
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.70 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.108 [secondary mapping, not verified]): s.70(2) a short-term capital loss may be set off against any other capital gain, short-term or long-term, of the same year; s.70(3) a long-term capital loss only against long-term capital gain

Income-tax Act 1961 s.74 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.111 [secondary mapping, not verified]): the net capital-gains loss of a year is carried forward to the following assessment year; (1)(a) a short-term loss 'shall be set off' against any capital gain of that year; (1)(b) a long-term loss only against long-term capital gain; (1)(c) the balance is carried on; (2) not for more than eight assessment years immediately succeeding the assessment year for which it was first computed

Income-tax Act 1961 s.80 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.121 [secondary mapping, not verified]) with s.139(3) and s.139(1): a capital loss is carried forward and set off under s.74 only if it was determined in a return filed within the time allowed by s.139(1)

Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % on long-term capital gains 'exceeding one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees' for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024; the gains are those included in total income, i.e. after the s.70 / s.74 set-off
Income-tax Act 1961 s.48 / s.2(42A): with no cost and no acquisition date the SAGE LTD gain and its character are unknown, so the year's net loss under s.74 is unknown
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: SAGE LTD: opening 2024-04-01, 100 units, no price and no date; sold 2024-11-04 @ 500.00 -> proceeds 50,000.00; cost, gain and term unknown (as g15).

FY 2024-25 (fy 2025): unknown_count 1 -> complete false; tax, cess, total null; losses_carried_* omitted (g15 convention). The SAGE gain could be long-term and absorb the LTCL, or a loss, so the year's unabsorbed loss is unknown.
Return for fy 2025 on time, but the amount is unknown -> ledger origin 2025 long, amount 40,000.00 (the LTCL of the classified disposals), remaining 40,000.00, last_fy 2033, unknown_amount.
fy 2026: the loss is excluded -> bf_set_off_long 0.00; carry_forward_complete false. exemption_used 1,25,000.00; taxable 80,000 x 0.125 = 10,000.00; cess 400.00; total 10,400.00.

ledger.count.reason: Engine convention (#344): the unabsorbed loss of a year with an unclassified disposal is unknown (amount null), because the unknown-cost sale may be a gain that absorbs the 40,000 within the year (s.70) or a further loss; and that possible loss gets its own ledger entry (kind 'unknown', status unknown_amount). The hand derivation shows the classified part, 40,000. Both readings keep the loss out of FY 2025-26's tax (total 10,400) and set carry_forward_complete false, so no tax figure differs.
